title: Licensing.
bodyText: A producer is not authorized to sell, solicit, or negotiate with respect to long-term care insurance except as authorized by article 9A.
bodyHtml: [§431:10H-202.5]  Licensing.  A producer is not authorized to sell, solicit, or negotiate with respect to long-term care insurance except as authorized by article 9A. [L 2007, c 233, pt of §4]
